name: FORNO® Como 24 in. 4.9 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Indoor/Outdoor Drawer Refrigerator
shortDescription: The Como 24-Inch Drawer Refrigerator – your ultimate indoor/outdoor solution for versatile beverage cooling. Its IPX4 waterproofing ensures resilience against the elements, making it perfect for any setting. Elevate your cooling experience with the Como 24-Inch Drawer Refrigerator – where durability meets elegance, indoors or out.

features.text: Enjoy the versatility of our drawer refrigerator, perfect for both indoor and outdoor use, boasting IPX4 waterproofing for added durability in any environment.
With a capacity to store up to 149 standard soda cans across its two drawers, organizing your beverages becomes effortless, aided by the added divider that come with the unit
Two spacious stainless steel 304 drawers and a total storage capacity of 4.87 cu. ft.
LED Light - Three high-efficiency LED lighting ensures bright, uniform illumination for easy visibility.
Experience consistent freshness throughout your refrigerator with our multi-airflow system, ensuring steady and even temperatures at every level.
No-frost refrigerator design eliminates the need for tedious defrosting. Enjoy hassle-free maintenance and maximize storage space.
Two sliding drawers equipped with telescopic rails, ensuring smooth usage every time.
Crafted with sturdy stainless steel 304 doors and drawers, this unit stands strong against any environment, whether it's the hustle of a busy kitchen or the elements of your outdoor bbq setup

With its stainless steel casing, this unit offers the flexibility to be installed either freestanding at the end of your counter or seamlessly built-in, allowing you to maximize your space according to your needs and preferences
The aluminum interior not only ensures easy cleaning after spills but also maintains its sharp appearance over time, guaranteeing a sleek and pristine look for years to come
